title: Enumerated Constant
text: Generate enumerated constant value, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Sample time} sets Sample time; {Output data type}, {Mode} sets the category of data and {Value} sets the enumerated value. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type Enum: SlDemoSign (default) | Enum:<ClassName>

params.name: Mode
params.values: Category of data to specify Enumerated (default)
